faq_en.q: Is the integration of online appointments on the dental website GDPR-compliant?
faq_en.a: Yes, absolutely. In web design for dentists, data protection is our top priority. We integrate proven systems like Doctolib, Jameda, or samedi 100% GDPR-compliant. Patient data flows securely end-to-end encrypted directly into your practice software, without any sensitive health data being temporarily stored on the website's web server.

faq_en.q: How can we use web design to better address and calm anxiety patients?
faq_en.a: Through radical transparency, warm color palettes, and empathy in design. On a modern dental website, we avoid off-putting treatment pictures or a cold, sterile clinic atmosphere. Instead, we show your sympathetic team in relaxed situations, bright rooms, and explain methods for anxiety-free treatment (e.g., laughing gas, twilight sleep, general anesthesia) in an extremely understandable, empathetic, and reassuring way.

faq_en.q: Does a new dental website also help with recruiting dental assistants (ZFA)?
faq_en.a: The shortage of skilled workers is currently one of the most massive problems in dental practices. A well-thought-out dentist web design specifically integrates modern career pages. Here, we attractively highlight your practice's benefits (paid further training, team events, 4-day work week, fair pay) and enable interested professionals to submit an extremely quick short application via smartphone in under 60 seconds – completely without a cover letter.

faq_en.q: Why do many existing practice websites load so slowly and why is that a problem?
faq_en.a: Often, huge, uncompressed images are used, or outdated, sluggish website builders (like old WordPress themes) are utilized. This frustrates patients and extremely harms your Google ranking. We develop your dentist web design using state-of-the-art technology (Next.js & React). Your new practice website will load in milliseconds, which Google rewards with significantly better positions in Local SEO.

faq_en.q: Do you also write the medical texts as part of the dentist web design process?
faq_en.a: Yes. We take over the complete SEO structuring and write appealing website texts that are medically absolutely correct, but easy and fluently understandable for the lay patient (we translate 'medical jargon' into patient benefits). If you prefer, we naturally also work hand-in-hand with your own texts and merely optimize them for search engines.

faq_en.q: We already have many patients. Why do we still need a premium web design for our dental practice?
faq_en.a: It's not about getting *more* patients, but attracting the *right* patients. If your practice is full anyway, the goal is often to increase the proportion of private treatments (e.g., implants, aesthetics). A premium dentist web design justifies your premium quality and prices at the treatment chair. It automatically filters out patients who are only looking for basic insurance services and specifically attracts self-payers and private patients.
